reviews.t: The perfect tool that my husband never knew he needed!
reviews.x: The perfect tool that my husband never knew he needed!  Before Christmas, my husband was complaining about perfecting the shape of his beard.  Of course, I started to look up gift ideas that could help and stumbled across this straightener.  He loves it and I do too!  This straightener gives his beard a much cleaner, sleeker look than before.  I will warn you that the way that he was trimming his beard before no longer worked since he started to use the straightener, so there was a bit of a lear

[[VIDEOID:8f1425309c5357af40359097b8876bed]] It came very well packed and so far I really like the function of this straightener. It’s easy to use and doesn’t look cheap at all. I spend quite a long time every morning doing my hair and this actually helps speeding it up. Will recommend to others.

The product box is generic and without any support, so a few of the bristles were broken off in transport. I don’t know if that reflects a cheap product and packaging, or implies shippers were too rough, but it was disappointing. It does an ok job getting my husband’s beard to fall in a more uniformed direction, but it’s a subtle change. It seems like the bristles are soaked too wide to get any grip on the hair to pull it straighter as it’s brushed through.
Doesn't straighten beard at all.  Useless.  Will be returning

reviews.t: I'm back to growing the beard out!
reviews.x: I have always had curly facial hair and after a few months, it gets to the point where it isn't presentable anymore. I've tried combing it but that didn't work. I was doing some research and heard a lot of good things on a beard straightener and decided to give it a try. My. girlfriend made fun of me and thought I was crazy. Just at first though. I really like the form factor of this is. It is easy to store in a suitcase or bag to take when I'm traveling and also stores nicely in my cabinet. It

I would recommend anyone who seriously cares about their beard to buy something else. I had teeth on the comb break off in the first couple of weeks. It is very easy to burn yourself as well. It defiantly will straighten your beard but I bought another hot comb that was just better constructed and haven't burnt myself. The other problem I had was the plug to this was not made for American outlets, not a huge problem because it cam with an adapter. But, it made it bulky and a bit more of a hassle

reviews.t: Every man who has long beard needs 1 of these!!!!
reviews.x: I have a beard for a long time now, mane it’s a big pain after taking a shower or after waking up to try to tame it with a hair dryer and a brush , i was skeptical ordering this at first but man... that little think works , it takes 3-5 minutes to get really hot and only 1 minute to have my beard ready for The day! It’s Saves me at least 15 minutes in the morning by not using the hairdryer ! It’s lightweight it’s small and it has long cable!!! Perfect for travel believe me!!

I was very skeptical about this product. There were so many different brands with almost the same thing. I got it in the mail, used it the same night... and within minutes, my beard hair went from coarse and curly to super straight and soft! I didn't realize my beard was that long! I looked like a chubby younger member of ZZ Top. It made my beard so much easier to trim, treat, and style. Definitely will recommend this to anyone with a beard, no matter the length.

Bought this for my husband after seeing it on a Facebook ad. My husband started growing his beard out about 2 years ago and it’s course and gets really curly. He usually struggles with balms and combing it to get it to lay right.  At first he thought it was a little funny, but he used it and actually really likes it. It smooths it out and makes it easier to manage. He just needs to figure out if he puts the oil in his beard before or after.

This was an early Father's Day Gift for my Father-in-Law because my Husband has one and his Dad wanted one too. He loves it! It is very durable, compact, convenient, gets hot, and works great!  This makes for a great gift ideal.  It heats up quickly and has an adjustable heat setting.  Matter of fact when I I want to straighten my bangs I use my husband's Straightening brush and it works well.

reviews.t: Slow warmup, no "ready" light, but very effective.
reviews.x: This product works extremely well on my unruly medium-length beard. It does require several minutes to reach operating temperature, and there's no "ready" light to tell you when it gets there, so you have to do a bit of planning and exercise some vigilance--but the results are worth it. The best way to tell it's up to temperature is by the scent it emits when fully heated.

I bought it for my husband since he has a pretty long beard. It works wonders , he also uses it for his hair. I think he likes it better for the hair than the beard. The straightener heats up super quick , and is not too hot for the face! Overall I am very happy I bought this.

Our first straighter has a loose connection and it would turn off and on, I contacted the company and they replaced it without  incident.  Wonderful people to deal with, would definitely recommend this product and the company!!

I was pleasantly surprised with this product! I bought this for my boyfriend who has a very wavy beard and its VERY effective. I was a little nervous at first (using a heating tool on his face) but even when i press it firmly against his beard to comb through the hair it doesn't burn him or feel uncomfortable. I have a short up-do hair style and I've used it several times to straighten back my hair! Very useful for us.

reviews.t: Does a decent job; not very sturdy; no overheat feature
reviews.x: While it does straighten my beard, there are some design flaws. Several bristles have broken off, and don’t stand up to regular use. See picture. It also lacks the overheat shut off feature described. Once it’s on it stays on, for HOURS, if you forget to turn it off.
Bought for my boyfriend and he likes to use it for his beard.  He recommends using a heat product on the hair first to avoid singed hair

I bought this for straightening my long beard. Basically every time I get out of the shower I use a comb and hair dryer to straighten my beard so I don’t look like I live in a cardboard box. I was hoping this device would be easier to use and take with me places. It works as described, but I got better results with a $10 hair dryer from Walmart. And the hair dryer works faster since you have to wait for this product to heat up. Also, be careful. You can burn your face with this, but that’s more

After my hairdryer died, I decided to try this product to help keep my beard frizz to a minimum. It's a straight forward product that works well. I like to give it about one minute to get warmed up prior to using it, so I just plug it in and turn it on while I'm pre-combing my beard to get any major tangles out. I've found that it works best for me if I comb slowly, using the lower heat setting. The only reason that I didn't give this product five stars is because the swivel feature on the power

My best man recommended this for my beard.  Works great.  I plug it in before I jump in the shower and it's ready to go when I finish drying off.  The power cord is a great length if your electrical outlet is by the sink.  The nubs help protect your skin from getting burned.  Even with this, I did manage to burn the bottom of my lower lip one of the first dozen times I used it, so be careful.  It's good for home and travel, small enough to fit in my medium sized shaving kit.  Takes up about the

I purchased the item 4 months ago and it worked great.  In the beginning, I could use the medium setting now I have to use high for it to work. Also, the iron teeth are breaking off.  I Know my beard is coarse and I use a comb prior to using the device. Needles to say short term great product but long term not so much.

This heated electric brush actually works!!, I have a curly/coarse beard,and now is so straight I'm having a hard time looking at it. The question is how long the brush will last. However, it does works, great value for the money, now I look like Charlton Heston in the Ten Commandments lol!!!.

This straightener is excellent. I plugged it in and it heated up in no time at all. It moved really smoothly through my husband's beard, and it took me no time at all to have it perfectly straight. He also said the it wasn't as hot as he had expected it to be being so close to his face.

If using this as a beard straightener suck in your lips or feel the burn. Also if you forget to turn this off and it sits for 30+ minutes, then it's probably ruined. The plastic tines that keep it away from your scalp / face on mine melted & fell off. I honestly don't recommend it.

Ok. This product does exactly what it says it will. My husband has a gnarly beard and with this it now looks well maintained and incredibly sleek. He found it easy to use with no fear of being burned. I recommend this for any guy with a beard!! Game changer!! 🙌🏼🙌🏼

Works good, just not great. I have a pretty thick beard, and even after leaving it preheat for 30 minutes on the highest setting, I still had stray hairs sticking out noticeably. That being said - it is better than nothing at all. A great value for the money.

claims.text: Most reviewers find the straightener effective at straightening beards, often describing fast, impressive results.
Several reviewers report broken bristles or teeth, sometimes during shipping and sometimes after regular use.
Reviewers frequently praise it as a great gift, especially for husbands, boyfriends, or fathers.
Some reviewers note it heats up slowly or lacks a ready light, though others say it heats quickly.
A few reviewers raise safety or design concerns, including risk of burns and a missing overheat shutoff feature.
